note: DRAFT knowledge. NONE of this is visible to the model: the Knowledge Gate filters to status=APPROVED before retrieval, so a DRAFT entry cannot be retrieved, cannot be cited, and cannot be verified. Each entry records what Dental Hub must confirm in writing before it may be promoted. Promotion is a deliberate human act through `knowledge import --approve`, and for a PRICE or OFFER the database will refuse it without a valid_until.

entries.title: خصم على Fomos Autoclave
entries.body: إعلان نشط في Meta Ad Library منذ 2026-08-11 يذكر «خصم 20 الف» على جهاز Fomos Autoclave.
entries.sourceCells: Issues & Complaints §B — Meta Ad Library, one active ad, start date 2026-08-11.
entries.evidence: The ad is real and the discount figure is quoted from its creative. The ad carries NO end date.
entries.blockedBy: knowledge_commercial_requires_expiry — an OFFER cannot be APPROVED without valid_until. Dental Hub must state the expiry date. Do not work around this constraint.
requiresConfirmation: Offer end date
Which model/configuration the discount applies to
Whether the discount is off list price or a bundle

entries.title: التقسيط والتمويل
entries.body: PLACEHOLDER — RL-04 opens with «أيوه فيه» (yes, instalments are available) and then leaves [عدد] شهور, مقدم [النسبة]%, [جهة التمويل] and [القسط] as placeholders.
entries.evidence: The audit found no evidence in the account that instalments are offered at all. The affirmative opening is the draft author's assumption, not a finding.
requiresConfirmation: Whether instalments are offered at all
Financing partner
Number of months
Down-payment percentage
Whether the terms differ by product

entries.title: الضمان
entries.body: PLACEHOLDER — RL-05 states «الضمان [المدة] على [ما يشمله]» plus «شامل الصيانة الدورية في السنة الأولى» and «قطع الغيار أصلية ومتوفرة».
entries.evidence: Duration and coverage are placeholders. The first-year maintenance claim and the genuine-spare-parts claim have no evidence in the audit.
requiresConfirmation: Warranty duration per product line
What the warranty covers and excludes
Whether first-year periodic maintenance is included
Whether a written warranty certificate exists

entries.title: الصيانة وخدمة ما بعد البيع
entries.body: PLACEHOLDER — RL-06 promises a maintenance team moving «في خلال [المدة] من البلاغ» and optional annual maintenance contracts.
entries.evidence: No response-time commitment is evidenced. RL-06's own 'avoid' column warns against promising unguaranteed appointments.
requiresConfirmation: Maintenance response time, if any is committed
Whether annual maintenance contracts exist and on what terms
Named after-sales owner

entries.title: التوصيل والتركيب
entries.body: PLACEHOLDER — RL-07 asserts «بنوصل ونركّب في كل محافظات مصر» and «التركيب والتدريب على الجهاز مجانًا مع الشراء», with delivery time left as [المدة].
entries.evidence: Nationwide coverage and free installation/training are commercial commitments with no supporting evidence anywhere in the audit.
requiresConfirmation: Which governorates are actually served
Whether installation and training are genuinely free
Delivery lead times

entries.title: ادعاء الوكالة الحصرية لـ Roson
entries.body: The client's own post caption describes Dental Hub as «الوكيل الحصري والمعتمد» for Roson units in Egypt.
entries.evidence: It is confirmed that the CLIENT made this claim. It is not confirmed that the claim is true. Exclusive-agency status is a legally substantiable statement in Egypt and requires the distribution agreement before this system repeats it.
requiresConfirmation: Written distribution/agency agreement
Territory and exclusivity scope
Current validity of the agreement

entries.title: ادعاء الأكثر مبيعًا
entries.body: The client's own post caption describes the Roson R2 Pro as «الأكثر مبيعًا في مصر».
entries.evidence: A market-share superlative with no cited source. Repeating it exposes the client to a substantiation challenge.
requiresConfirmation: Independent market data supporting the superlative

entries.title: ساعات العمل
entries.evidence: These hours are the audit's proposal for SLA measurement windows, not Dental Hub's published hours. No opening hours were found on the page.
requiresConfirmation: Actual published business hours

entries.title: التزامات زمن الرد
entries.body: PROPOSED — first reply within 1 business hour on DM, 2 hours on comments, 30 minutes on WhatsApp; quotation within 24 hours.
entries.evidence: The sheet states plainly that Dental Hub has no documented SLA and no evidence of one was found. These are targets proposed by the audit. Stating them to a customer would create a commitment the business has not made.
requiresConfirmation: Whether management adopts these targets as commitments
